(Japanese: '''ダイヤ''' ''Dia'') is a character from {{OBP|Pocket Monsters DP|Kosaku Anakubo}} who appeared in ''[[PMDP10|A Fresh Rival Appears!?]]''. Dia is based on {{ga|Lucas}} from the {{v|Diamond and Pearl|s}} games and is one of {{PPM|Red}}'s [[rival]]s.

==Character==
Dia is considered to be well known around Sinnoh as a bunch of {{tc|Cameraman|Cameramen}} took pictures of him and did interviews as well.

==History==
A bunch of {{tc|Cameraman|Cameramen}} are speeding along and easily zoom past Red and his Pokémon. They start taking pictures and doing interviews with a Trainer named Dia. Red and his Pokémon notice that many copies of newsprint containing Dia and his Pokémon were published. They leave afterwards and {{TP|Red|Clefairy}}, hiding behind a wall, wants to surprise him. Clefairy runs to Dia with Red chasing after the {{type|Normal}} but at the last minute stops and holds out a piece of paper, asking Dia for an autograph.

Dia notices Red and they introduce themselves to each other. After giving each other a hand shake, Red noticed that his hand was dirty and then Dia shyly reacts to it. Dia then tries pumping up Red and his Pokémon for a battle. During the battle, Dia's {{p|Mime Jr.}} and {{p|Weavile}} drew to {{PPM|Red's Pikachu}} and {{TP|Red|Tyrogue}}, and his {{p|Munchlax}} lost to Red's Clefairy.

Following the battle, Dia and Red went after Munchlax and Clefairy when they went running off in order to compete with each other. After they found their Pokémon, they were furious to see that they were eating.
